declarations.doc: Enabled only on even x: intermittently enabled along the main loop.
declarations.name: fire

declarations.doc:
Weak fairness is NOT enough: the fair run 0,1,2,3,0,... enables
`fire` only intermittently, so WF(fire) is vacuously satisfied —
the counterexample is the real 4-state cycle (fails).
declarations.name: brokenWeakFire

declarations.doc: Strong fairness forces `fire` on the 0,1,2,3 cycle (holds).
declarations.name: strongFire

42.doc: Holds: with weak fairness on the increment, x reaches 3.
42.name: fairReach

62.doc:
Fails: 5 is simply unreachable — the counterexample is a real cycle
0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 0, not a stutter loop (step has no stutter branch,
but TLA stuttering closure also admits stutter lassos) (fails).
62.name: brokenReachFive

72.doc: Holds under fairness: every fair run cycles through 0 forever.
72.name: fairRevisitZero

78.doc: Fails without fairness: stutter at x == 1 forever (fails).
78.name: brokenRevisitZero
